description: Source code implementing file descriptor event handling functions for socket and file operations, including socket creation with cloexec and non-blocking flags, file loading, process spawning, and socket options.

methods.name: fdevent_socket_nb_cloexec_init
methods.description: Initializes socket support for non-blocking and cloexec flags based on kernel support.

methods.name: fdevent_setfd_cloexec
methods.description: Sets the close-on-exec flag on a file descriptor.

methods.name: fdevent_clrfd_cloexec
methods.description: Clears the close-on-exec flag on a file descriptor.

methods.name: fdevent_fcntl_set_nb
methods.description: Sets a file descriptor to non-blocking mode.

methods.name: fdevent_fcntl_set_nb_cloexec
methods.description: Sets a file descriptor to non-blocking mode and sets cloexec.

methods.name: fdevent_fcntl_set_nb_cloexec_sock
methods.description: Sets a socket to non-blocking and cloexec if supported.

methods.name: fdevent_socket_cloexec
methods.description: Creates a socket with cloexec support if available.

methods.name: fdevent_socket_nb_cloexec
methods.description: Creates a non-blocking, cloexec socket if supported.

methods.name: fdevent_dup_cloexec
methods.description: Duplicates a file descriptor with cloexec support.

methods.name: fdevent_open_cloexec
methods.description: Opens a file with cloexec and flags, handling symlinks.

methods.name: fdevent_open_devnull
methods.description: Opens /dev/null with appropriate flags.

methods.name: fdevent_open_dirname
methods.description: Opens the directory part of a path.

methods.name: fdevent_pipe_cloexec
methods.description: Creates a pipe with cloexec support.

methods.name: fdevent_socket_close
methods.description: Closes a socket.

methods.name: fdevent_mkostemp
methods.description: Creates a temporary file with cloexec support.

methods.name: fdevent_accept_listenfd
methods.description: Accepts a connection on a listening socket with support for cloexec and non-blocking.

methods.name: fdevent_environ
methods.description: Returns the environment variables.

methods.name: fdevent_set_stdin_stdout_stderr
methods.description: Redirects stdin, stdout, and stderr to specified file descriptors.

methods.name: fdevent_rename
methods.description: Renames a file.

methods.name: fdevent_fork_execve
methods.description: Forks and executes a new process with specified file descriptors and working directory.

methods.name: fdevent_sh_exec
methods.description: Executes a shell command, possibly bypassing shell expansion.

methods.name: fdevent_kill
methods.description: Sends a signal to a process.

methods.name: fdevent_waitpid
methods.description: Waits for a process to change state.

methods.name: fdevent_waitpid_intr
methods.description: Interruptible wait for a process to change state.

methods.name: fdevent_socket_read_discard
methods.description: Reads and discards data from a socket.

methods.name: fdevent_ioctl_fionread
methods.description: Performs ioctl to get number of bytes available for reading.

methods.name: fdevent_connect_status
methods.description: Checks the status of a non-blocking connect.

methods.name: fdevent_is_tcp_half_closed
methods.description: Checks if a TCP socket is in half-closed state.

methods.name: fdevent_set_tcp_nodelay
methods.description: Sets TCP_NODELAY option on a socket.

methods.name: fdevent_set_so_reuseaddr
methods.description: Sets SO_REUSEADDR option on a socket.

methods.name: fdevent_load_file
methods.description: Loads entire file contents into memory, with support for regular and non-regular files.

methods.name: fdevent_load_file_bytes
methods.description: Loads a specific number of bytes from a file into a buffer.
